verdict.rationale: Community Phone documents voicemail-to-email that delivers audio files and transcripts to your inbox, plus voicemail transcription on business plans and voicemails you can read as texts. That covers reading voicemails without dialing in. missing for 10: voicemail-to-email is described only in a porting blog post rather than in plan or feature docs, no chat-app delivery is shown, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, voicemails are transcribed and delivered to email or chat so I can read them without dialing in

citations.quote: Voicemail-to-email: Access your voicemails as audio files and transcripts in your mail without logging into your voicemail box.
voicemail you can listen to in the app or read as texts
